sources.title: SCHOTT TIE-29：折射率與色散
sources.titleEn: SCHOTT TIE-29: Refractive Index and Dispersion
sources.scope: 玻璃廠技術資料：阿貝數、相對部分色散 P_g,F、正常線 0.6438 − 0.001682·ν_d 與偏離量 ΔP_g,F，以及二級光譜修正的選材原則。

sources.imageReuse: Link only. No source image or article reproduction.

sources.title: SCHOTT TIE-19：折射率溫度係數
sources.titleEn: SCHOTT TIE-19: Temperature Coefficient of the Refractive Index
sources.scope: 玻璃廠技術資料：絕對與相對 dn/dT、N-BK7 與 F2 等玻璃的 e 線數值、熱光常數 G 與無熱化選材。
sources.scopeEn: Glassmaker technical note: absolute versus relative dn/dT, e-line values for glasses such as N-BK7 and F2, the thermo-optical constant G and athermal glass selection.
sources.imageReuse: Link only. No source image or article reproduction.

courses.overview: 從「消色差透鏡設計」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Achromatic lens design into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: ASML 微影機系統工程
related.why: 把「消色差透鏡設計」與「ASML 微影機系統工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Achromatic lens design with ASML Lithography Systems Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 成像品質要透過像差、孔徑和對位共同評估，不能把解析度只歸因於放大倍率。
related.transferEn: Image quality depends on aberrations, aperture and alignment rather than magnification alone.
related.difference: 可見光消色差雙合透鏡利用不同材料的色散互補；EUV 微影主要使用多層膜反射鏡，不能照搬透鏡解法。
related.differenceEn: Visible-light achromatic doublets combine material dispersions; EUV lithography mainly uses multilayer mirrors, so the lens solution cannot be transferred directly.
practice: 分別畫出透射與反射光路
說明為何材料透明性限制光學架構
practiceEn: Draw transmitted and reflected ray paths
Explain how material transparency constrains optical architecture

related.title: James Webb 太空望遠鏡
related.why: 把「消色差透鏡設計」與「James Webb 太空望遠鏡」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Achromatic lens design with James Webb Space Telescope: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate ground-campus point, never Webb coordinates in space, live ephemerides or a control-room location; the map pins this coordinate and the official campus address is listed separately.

related.transfer: 精密光學要以波段、像差和熱形變建立誤差預算，最後用實測波前或影像驗證。
related.transferEn: Precision optics require error budgets for wavelength, aberrations and thermal distortion, followed by wavefront or image measurements.
related.difference: 消色差透鏡補償折射色散；Webb 使用分段反射鏡和低溫環境，主要問題是鏡段共相與熱穩定。
related.differenceEn: Achromatic lenses compensate refractive dispersion; Webb uses segmented mirrors in a cold environment, emphasizing segment phasing and thermal stability.
practice: 比較雙合透鏡與分段反射鏡
標出溫度變化會改變的尺寸
為色差與鏡段失準各選一種觀察量
practiceEn: Compare a doublet with a segmented reflector
Choose observables for chromatic error and segment misalignment

courses.summary:
消色差透鏡的歷史早於近代光學產業；這裡選擇的是現代精密光學供應與教育的代表點，並非發明地。Edmund Optics 的 Barrington 據點公開列有工程、製造、品保及配送職能，提醒學徒：設計好的光學元件還需要可製造、可測試與可追溯。

Norman Edmund 於 1942 年在 Collingswood 開始販售光學器材，1948 年遷入 Barrington。兩個節點說明光學知識如何透過元件、型錄及工程支援傳播。座標為城鎮代表位置，地圖查詢使用官方地址，不表示每款透鏡都在此生產或可直接入廠。
courses.summaryEn:
Achromats predate the modern optics industry. This site represents precision-optics supply and education rather than invention. Edmund Optics lists engineering, manufacturing, quality and distribution functions in Barrington, reminding learners that an optical design also needs manufacturability, testability and traceability.

Norman Edmund began selling optics in Collingswood in 1942, and the business moved to Barrington in 1948. These milestones illustrate dissemination through components, catalogs and engineering support. Coordinates represent the town and map lookup uses the official address; production of every lens and public factory access are not implied.

history.title: 光學器材事業起步
history.text: Norman Edmund 在 Collingswood 經營 Edmund Salvage，向光學愛好者供應器材。
history.textEn: Norman Edmund operated Edmund Salvage in Collingswood, supplying optics to enthusiasts.

history.title: 遷入 Barrington
history.text: Edmund Scientific 從 Collingswood 遷至 Barrington，形成後續企業據點。
history.textEn: Edmund Scientific moved from Collingswood to Barrington, establishing its later corporate location.
